title: Microsoft 365 admin center: email notifications for organizational data processing status
summary: Held because the mixed licensing classification is not supported: Microsoft documents the surrounding service's existing application licences, not a mixed entitlement for these notifications. The planned default, dates and validation-status navigation are supported; the unsubscribe and email-detail gaps remain unconfirmed by documentation.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service brings employee data from HR systems and other sources into Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Workday is a documented connector option.

claims.claim: SAP SuccessFactors is a documented connector option.
claims.quote: SAP SuccessFactors Connector | Microsoft pulls data directly from SAP SuccessFactors's public APIs using SAP SuccessFactors credentials that you provide.

claims.claim: Azure Blob Storage is a documented connector option.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Licensing requirements for the surrounding service vary with the Microsoft 365 or Viva app consuming the data.
claims.quote: Licensing requirements vary based on the Microsoft 365 or Viva app that will consume organizational data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: These notifications have a mixed licensing model.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service notification unsubscribe Microsoft Graph beta PowerShell license pricing meter; "organizational data" "notifications" "license". Opened get-started: it lists existing consuming-app licences, not mixed notification entitlement.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included' under the standard's rule for a new option inside an already licensed product. Retain the notes that service licensing depends on the consuming app and that a licence specific to these notifications is not yet published; https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/org-data-service/get-started documents the general requirements.
